result.topic_en: Draft of a university lecture announcement (Latin and German) for Riemann's courses on the mathematical theory of gravitation, electricity and magnetism, and on functions of a complex variable, especially elliptic and Abelian functions; it is preceded by an unrelated note on a letter or postal item.

items.quote:
Theoriam gravitatis, [-magnetismi-] electricitatis & magnetismi mathematicam
exponet [-...-] quinquies h. IX–X
items.english: He will present the mathematical theory of gravitation, electricity and magnetism five times weekly, 9–10 o'clock.

items.quote: functiones complexae quantitatis variabilis tractabit, imprimis ellipticas et Abelianas quaternis scholis h. X–XI
items.english: He will treat functions of a complex variable, especially elliptic and Abelian ones, in four lectures a week, 10–11 o'clock.
